name: cinerank-project
description: Personal movie-ranking app with a growing taste profile, TMDB-grounded AI recommendations, and a fully audited AI call log.
_comment_overrides: Express 4 pins qs to exactly 6.15.3, which carries two moderate advisories (GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx array-limit bypass, GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g DoS via isBuffer). npm audit fix cannot resolve them — even with --force — because the exact pin leaves no semver room, and the only other route is Express 5, a major version with breaking changes. This override lifts qs to the patched 6.16.0, a minor bump. qs is Express's query-string parser, which is exactly what test/routes.test.js exercises (search query strings, JSON bodies), so the suite covers the risk. Remove this when the project moves to Express 5.
